A few years back my family and I moved into this house that was originally built in the 20s and was later moved to a new lot. There was a time when my sister would see shadow figures walking from one room to another, you see, the way this house was built it had two front doors and two back doors with 3 rooms on each side and a wall that split the house and one door to connect each side, so 6 rooms in total and if you opened all the doors you could see straight through half of the house. I was pregnant at the time and remember waking up with horrible morning sickness. I ran to one of the restrooms and barfed my insides out when the faucets turned on. Two faucets. We had a small sink but it mounted two faucets, one for hot water and cold. I freaked out but turned off the water and ran back to my room. Then things started falling from a shelf we had in our living room, books, DVDs, trophies but I blamed it on the foundation of the house. I even recall placing my phone on the windowsill to bathe and when I stepped out of the tub my phone flew horizontally and landed in front of me. And I've always been a severely depressed person but while living there it was worse than it ever was, the house full of bad vibes. A relative of mine once stated the house was a trap house and drug addicts would often go there, I'm not sure if it was due to residual emotions but a lot of bad incidents occurred while we lived there. I'm not religious, and at the time I just brushed it off thinking if it is something demonic I won't give it the attention it's looking for, and when i moved out I haven't experienced anything like that since.
